n: You commit at the very end, in front of Fractured Marika — so gather every Mending Rune you can, then pick. Only three endings carry achievements; the other three all resolve as Elden Lord.

g.name: Endings
items: Age of Fracture::The default. Beat Radagon and the Elden Beast, then touch Fractured Marika with no Mending Rune. → "Elden Lord"
Age of the Duskborn::Finish Fia's quest for the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince (requires beating Lichdragon Fortissax). → "Elden Lord"
Blessing of Despair::Finish the Dung Eater's quest for the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse (five Seedbed Curses). → "Elden Lord"
Age of Order::Finish Goldmask and Brother Corhyn's quest for the Mending Rune of Perfect Order. → "Elden Lord"
Lord of Frenzied Flame::Strip naked in the sealed basement under the Cathedral of the Forsaken and touch the Three Fingers. Own achievement.
Age of the Stars::Complete Ranni's questline, then summon her at Fractured Marika. Own achievement.

g.name: Ending mechanics
items: Undo the Frenzied Flame::The Frenzied Flame locks out every other ending. Reverse it with Miquella's Needle — bring the Unalloyed Gold Needle to Dragonlord Placidusax's arena in Crumbling Farum Azula.

g.name: Ending mechanics — Shadow Realm
items: Shadow of the Erdtree has no separate ending::Beating Promised Consort Radahn completes the DLC story and returns you to the base game's ending choice.

n: Every questline, with the points where a path closes another off. Anything flagged as a choice cannot be undone in the same save.

g.name: Base game
items: Ranni the Witch::Renna's Rise → Nokron → Fingerslayer Blade → Carian Study Hall → Lake of Rot → Astel → Moonlight Altar. Yields the Dark Moon Greatsword and the Age of the Stars ending.
Blaidd::Mistwood → runs alongside Ranni. After her quest he goes feral at the Forlorn Hound Evergaol; kill him for Blaidd's Set and the Royal Greatsword.
Iji the Blacksmith::Sells Somber stones and upgrades. Dies partway through Ranni's questline — buy from him early.
Preceptor Seluvis:: Choice — give the Amber Starlight to Ranni, or use Seluvis's Potion on Nepheli or the Dung Eater. Puppetizing Nepheli ends her quest for good.
Sorcerer Rogier::Stormveil → the Black Knife investigation → his death. Gives Rogier's Rapier and the introduction to Ranni.
Nepheli Loux::Stormveil → Roundtable → Village of the Albinaurics for the Stormhawk King → the throne room. Choice — mutually exclusive with Seluvis's puppet.
Kenneth Haight::Fort Haight, then Godrick's throne room. Competes with Nepheli for the Lordship of Limgrave.
Irina & Edgar::Castle Morne. Choice — deliver Irina's letter and Edgar later invades at Revenger's Shack, or leave it and he stays put.
Boc the Seamster::Choice — use the Prattling Pate "You're Beautiful" and he lives, giving the Gold Sewing Needle; give him a Larval Tear instead and he dies.
Thops::Church of Irith → the Academy Glintstone Key → his body in the Schoolhouse Classroom. Thops's Barrier and Bell Bearing.
Latenna the Albinauric::Slumbering Wolf's Shack → Lakeside Crystal Cave → carry her to the Apostate Derelict in the Consecrated Snowfield.
Millicent::Choice — at the Haligtree, fight her four sisters for the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, or side with the sisters and kill her for Millicent's Prosthesis and the Unalloyed Gold Needle.
Gowry::Sellia → Gowry's Shack. Drives Millicent's quest; can be killed for Pest Threads.
Sorceress Sellen::Choice — help Sellen and kill Witch-Hunter Jerren, or help Jerren and kill Sellen. Different rewards; you cannot have both.
Alexander, Warrior Jar::Limgrave → Gael Tunnel → the Radahn Festival → Mt. Gelmir → a duel in Crumbling Farum Azula. Shard of Alexander.
Diallos::Roundtable → Volcano Manor → Jarburg, where he dies defending the jars.
Jar-Bairn::Jarburg, threaded through Diallos. Companion Jar and the Ritual Pot recipe.
Patches::Murkwater Cave — spare him — then Scenic Isle, Volcano Manor, the Shaded Castle and Mohgwyn Palace.
Tanith & Volcano Manor::Three assassination contracts: Old Knight Istvan, Rileigh the Idle, Juno Hoslow. Choice — after Rykard dies Tanith turns hostile; kill her for the Consort's Set.
Knight Bernahl::Volcano Manor, then he invades in Crumbling Farum Azula for the Devourer's Scepter. Choice — killing him early at the Warmaster's Shack forfeits that legendary armament.
Rya / Zorayas::Liurnia → Volcano Manor. Her true form and the Daedicar's Woe talisman depend on how you handle the Serpent's Amnion.
Blackguard Big Boggart::Boilprawn Shack → the necklace choice in Rya's quest → Mohgwyn Palace, where he dies.
White Mask Varré::Choice — soak the Festering Bloody Finger in three Maidens' blood for early access to Mohgwyn Palace, or refuse and kill him for his set.
Bloody Finger Hunter Yura::Limgrave → Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger → the Nagakiba. He is later reborn as Shabriri.
Hyetta::Lake-Facing Cliffs, five Fingerprint Grapes. Tied to the Frenzied Flame path; yields the Frenzied Flame Seal.
Fia, Deathbed Companion::Roundtable → Deeproot Depths → Fia's Champions → Lichdragon Fortissax → the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince.
D, Hunter of the Dead::Choice — give D's Bell Bearing and the Twinned Armor to his brother and he slays Fia (Inseparable Sword), or withhold it and keep Fia's rewards.
The Dung Eater::Choice — feed him five Seedbed Curses for the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse and the Sword of Milos; or purify him with Seluvis's Potion; or simply kill him.
Brother Corhyn & Goldmask::Altus → the Golden Order Principia → the Mending Rune of Perfect Order. Corhyn can be lost to madness in Leyndell if you delay.
Gurranq, Beast Clergyman::Nine Deathroot deliveries at the Bestial Sanctum. Stop feeding him when he turns hostile, or pacify him with the Bestial Sanctum bell.
Sir Gideon Ofnir::Gathers intelligence at the Roundtable, then fights you in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
Melina::Accompanies you and kindles the Erdtree — unless you take the Frenzied Flame, at which point she abandons you.
Roderika::Stormhill Shack → Roundtable Hold, where she becomes the Spirit Tuner and upgrades your ashes.
Smithing Master Hewg::Roundtable Hold. His arc resolves through Roderika's.
Enia, Finger Reader::Trades every Remembrance at the Roundtable Hold.
Witch-Hunter Jerren::Runs the Radahn Festival and closes out Sellen's questline.

g.name: Shadow of the Erdtree
items: Needle Knight Leda::The hub of the DLC's NPC web. The final fight at Enir-Ilim fields a different roster of allies and enemies depending on whose side you took along the way.
Hornsent::A vengeance quest running through Belurat and Bonny Village. Choice — he can end as an ally or as an enemy at Enir-Ilim.
Hornsent Grandam::Must be started before you beat Messmer. Wear the Divine Beast Head to speak with her; return after Messmer for a second reward.
Sir Ansbach::Choice — side with him and he can be summoned for the final boss, or side with Leda and fight him.
Thiollier & St. Trina::Choice — carry St. Trina's wish back to Thiollier, or take the other path. One route makes him summonable for Promised Consort Radahn.
Redmane Freyja::Choice — ends as an ally or an enemy at Enir-Ilim depending on your answers.
Moore::Choice — he can be killed after his despair at Charo's Hidden Grave.
Igon::Summon him against Bayle the Dread for Igon's Set and Igon's Greatbow. Still doable after the main story.
Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers::Cathedral of Manus Metyr → the Finger Ruins → Metyr. Choice — kill Ymir, or leave him be.
Swordhand of Night Jolán::Threaded through Ymir's quest. Outcomes decide whether you get Jolán's ashes alone or Jolán and Anna.
Dryleaf Dane::A chain of hand-to-hand duels. Dane's Footwork and Dane's Set.
Fire Knight Queelign::Repeated invasions across the Shadow Realm. Fire Knight's Seal and Queelign's Greatsword. Still doable after the main story.
